name: arts, culture, entertainment and media
definition: All forms of arts, entertainment, cultural heritage and media

name: arts and entertainment
definition: All forms of arts and entertainment

name: animation
definition: Stories told through animated drawings in either full-length or short format

name: cartoon
definition: Drawings, such as editorial cartoons and comic strips, often using humour or satire

name: cinema
definition: Stories told through motion pictures, such as full-length or short format documentary or fictional features

name: dance
definition: A form of performing art consisting of purposefully selected sequences of human movement

name: ballet
definition: A classical dance form based on formal gestures, steps and postures

name: modern dance
definition: A theatrical dance style based on free-style expression rather than formal gestures

name: traditional dance
definition: Dance style that reflects the life and culture of a specific group of people or region, such as folk and ceremonial dance

name: fashion
definition: Styles and trends in clothing, footwear, accessories, including the design, presentation and wearing of these styles and trends

name: cosmetics
definition: Products applied to the body to enhance appearance, such as lipstick, eyeliner, foundation and nail polish, and the trends surrounding the application of these products

name: hairstyles
definition: Trends surrounding the cutting and styling of hair

name: jewellery
definition: Decorative items worn for personal expression and adornment, such as rings, necklaces, earrings

name: festival
definition: Events showcasing artistic endeavours, often regularly occurring, such as dance, music, theatre, poetry or comedy festivals

name: film festival
definition: All forms of national and international film festivals

name: literature
definition: The telling of a story through written language

name: drama (literature)
definition: Work written to be performed on the stage

name: fiction
definition: Written works that are not based on fact, but are the creation of the author's imagination

name: non-fiction
definition: Written works that are based on fact

name: poetry
definition: Written works that use the aesthetic and rhythmic qualities of language to express a message or emotion

name: music
definition: A form of performing art using instruments or voice to create different sounds, tones and harmonies

name: musical genre
definition: A distinguishable type of music

name: children's music
definition: A genre of music featuring songs composed and performed for children

name: classical music
definition: A genre of music rooted in the traditions of Western music, including both religious and secular music, such as symphony, concerto and sonata.

name: country music
definition: A genre of music that originated in the southern United States, often consisting of ballads or dance tunes and featuring string instruments such as banjos, fiddles and guitars

name: dance band music
definition: A Swedish genre of music characterized by music inspired by swing, schlager, country, jazz and rock that is often danced to in pairs

name: electronic dance music
definition: A genre of music that employs electronic instruments and is primarily made for nightclubs, raves, and festivals

name: folk music
definition: A genre of music that developed from traditional popular cultures, often based on story telling

name: heavy metal
definition: A genre of loud, aggressive rock music that was developed in the late 1960s and early 1970s

name: hip hop
definition: A genre of music developed in African American communities in the United States in the 1970s which consists of rapping usually with an electronic backing

name: jazz music
definition: A genre of music with roots in blues and ragtime that originated in African American communities of New Orleans in the United States in the late 19th and early 20th centuries

name: popular music
definition: A genre of music that is widely accessible and designed to appeal to all

name: r&b
definition: A genre of music originated in African American communities in the 1940s and featuring soulful vocals

name: rock and roll music
definition: A genre of music that originated in the United States during the late 1940s and early 1950s, evolving from African American musical styles such as gospel, jump blues, jazz, boogie woogie, and rhythm and blues.

name: musical instrument
definition: Objects used to play music on

name: musical performance
definition: Musicians performing for an audience for the purpose of entertainment

name: series
definition: A connected set of fictional or non-fictional program episodes that run under the same title.

name: theatre
definition: A form of performing art where live performers portray a narrative to an audience through dialogue and action

name: cabaret
definition: A form of theatrical entertainment featuring music, song, dance, recitation, or drama that is performed in a nightclub or restaurant while the audience eats or drinks at tables

name: drama (theatre)
definition: A genre of theatre where dramatic or comedic plays are performed on the stage

name: music theatre (retired)
definition: A form of performing art where live performers portray a narrative to an audience through song, dialogue and action, such as musicals and operettas (retired)

name: musical
definition: A genre of music theatre in which singing and dancing play an essential part of the storytelling

name: opera
definition: A form of performing art where classically trained musicians and singers perform a musical and dramatic work

name: operetta
definition: A genre of music theatre that usually has a light or humorous theme where some of the libretto is usually spoken rather than sung.

name: stand-up comedy
definition: A comic style in which a comedian performs a series of jokes or stories in front of a live audience, usually speaking directly to them

name: visual arts
definition: A form of art which appeals primarily to the visual senses, such as ceramics, drawing, painting, sculpture, printmaking, design, crafts, photography, video, filmmaking, and architecture.

name: architecture
definition: The design of buildings, monuments and the spaces around them

name: design (visual arts)
definition: An artistic discipline which focuses on visual communication and presentation, the final product of which can range from jewellery to interior design

name: drawing
definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as pencils, markers, pen and ink, charcoal

name: forging
definition: The shaping of metal using localized compressive forces, such as heating and hammering

name: painting
definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as oil paint, watercolour, pastel, crayon

name: photography
definition: A form of visual arts using photographic images

name: sculpture
definition: A form of visual arts using mediums such as clay, stone, wood and metal to create three-dimensional works

name: textile arts
definition: Arts and crafts that use plant, animal, or synthetic fibres to construct practical or decorative object

name: woodworking
definition: The activity or skill of making items, such as furniture or cabinets, from wood

name: culture
definition: The ideas, customs, arts, traditions of a particular group of persons

name: art exhibition
definition: Temporary presentation of art in museums, art halls or galleries

name: cultural development
definition: The history of the development of art and culture such as the rise of cave paintings, linguistic variations over time, the evolution of values

name: customs and tradition
definition: A particular way of behaving, or observances that have developed over time by a group of people

name: festive event (culture)
definition: An event ordinarily celebrated by a community and centring on some characteristic aspect of that community and its religion or traditions

name: language
definition: The method of human communication, either spoken or written, consisting of words that are used in a structured and conventional way

name: library and museum
definition: Institutions that house collections of books, music, art, or objects from the past and present optionally for public use and display

name: monument and heritage site
definition: Commemorations of historical people, events, or the areas containing them, in the form of structures such as sculptures, statues or buildings

name: restoration
definition: Restoring historic or important properties or structures to a former better state by cleaning, repairing or rebuilding

name: mass media
definition: Media addressing a large audience

name: disinformation and misinformation
definition: The spread of false information regardless of intent

name: news media
definition: The presentation of news to the public through different platforms, such as TV, radio, newspapers, magazines, web pages and blogs

name: newspaper
definition: Daily or weekly publication that presents the news, locally, regionally or globally, as well as features, opinion columns, comics and other content

name: online media outlet
definition: Publication distributing content, such as articles, blogs, photos, video and music, only over the internet

name: periodical
definition: Publication that is usually published weekly, bi-weekly, monthly or annually, such as magazines, journals or newsletters

name: radio
definition: Audio content, such as news, entertainment or information, distributed via broadcast or internet

name: social media
definition: Content created to be shared within online social networks

name: influencers
definition: Persons who distribute content on internet forums and social media and are followed by many people thereby influencing them to buy and use products

name: television
definition: Video content, such as news, entertainment or information, distributed via broadcast or internet

name: conflict, war and peace
definition: Acts of socially or politically motivated protest or violence, military activities, geopolitical conflicts, as well as resolution efforts

name: act of terror
definition: Act of violence, often resulting in casualties, designed to raise fear and anxiety in a population

name: act of bioterrorism
definition: Attacks using biological agents intended to raise the level of fear within a population

name: terrorist bombings
definition: Intentional use of explosive devices on people, buildings or other structures

name: armed conflict
definition: Disputes between opposing groups involving the use of weapons, but not necessarily formally declared wars

name: guerrilla activity
definition: Anti-government or wartime actions by clandestine or non-state combatant groups, often using tactics such as ambush, sabotage, raids and kidnapping

name: international military intervention
definition: The temporary use of international forces in a country or region that requires outside help with resolving a crisis

name: military occupation
definition: The temporary forceful taking over of a country or region by invading military forces

name: war
definition: Armed hostilities by one group or geopolitical entity against another

name: civil war
definition: Armed conflict between members of the same country, in some cases with the goal of dividing the country

name: war crime action (retired)
definition: Actions alleged as crimes committed during a war or armed conflict, usually against civilians or POWs (retired)

name: civil unrest
definition: Rallies, strikes, demonstrations, riots or other disturbances by a population, often in protest to a government or other organization's policies or actions

name: protests and demonstrations
definition: A non-violent public show of support for or opposition to a cause, idea or policy, in the form of a mass meeting or march

name: rebellion
definition: Organized actions of opposition to a government or ruling party by a country's residents, often violent and with the aim of overthrowing the government

name: revolution
definition: A forcible and often violent change to, or overthrow of, a country's political system or social order by internal forces, in favour of a new system

name: riot
definition: Violent, destructive events of civil disorder by groups of people, usually in response to a grievance or as acts of opposition, often involving injury to individuals and destruction of property

name: coup d'etat
definition: The overthrow of an established government by an organised military or political group

name: cyber warfare
definition: Cyber attacks, or suspected attacks, involving a government entity as either the sponsor or the target, or preventive measures against these types of actions

name: massacre
definition: The mass killing of people, usually civilians, during wartime hostilities

name: peace process
definition: Organized actions to end a war or conflict, usually involving peace negotiations and agreements

name: disarmament
definition: The abolishment or reduction of a country's military weapons cache

name: peace envoy
definition: Person or organisation initiating and carrying out a peace process

name: peace plan
definition: A strategy for achieving peace in a warring nation or area of conflict

name: peace talks
definition: Discussions between countries, world regions or geopolitical entities in conflict or at war, often with a mediator, with the goal of arriving at a solution for peace

name: peacekeeping force
definition: The military forces of a nation, or of several nations working together, whose mission is to maintain peace in areas of conflict

name: post-war reconstruction
definition: Actions to rebuild a society, economy or political system in an area affected by war

name: ordnance clearance
definition: The removal or neutralisation of ordnance such as landmines or cluster bombs that may remain after a war or armed conflict on public ground

name: war victims
definition: Individuals who are injured or killed in a war or armed conflict, including civilians

name: missing in action
definition: Civilians or military personnel who have gone missing during or after hostilities, conflicts or war

name: missing in action (retired)
definition: A member of the armed forces who cannot be located and has not been confirmed as either alive or dead (retired)

name: prisoners of war
definition: Individuals captured, imprisoned or detained by enemy factions during military conflicts or war

name: crime, law and justice
definition: The establishment and/or statement of the rules of behaviour in society, the enforcement of these rules, breaches of the rules, the punishment of offenders and the organisations and bodies involved in these activities

name: crime
definition: Violations of laws by individuals, companies or organisations

name: animal abuse
definition: The infliction of cruelty or neglect onto animals by humans

name: arson
definition: The intentional setting of fires with criminal intent

name: assault
definition: Physical crime against a person, including battery, brawls and threat of bodily harm

name: sex crime
definition: Sexual crimes against a person, such as rape, harassment, molestation or groping

name: corporate crime
definition: Crimes committed by a corporation or by individuals acting on behalf of a corporation

name: accounting crime
definition: The intentional misrepresentation or alteration of accounting records regarding sales, revenues, expenses and other factors

name: anti-trust crime
definition: Violations of laws aimed at corporations to promote fair competition for the benefit of consumers

name: breach of contract
definition: The breaking of terms set in a contractual agreement

name: embezzlement
definition: The intentional theft or misuse of money left in one's care or belonging to one's employer

name: insider trading
definition: Trading of stocks by persons having access to internal information not made public at the time

name: restraint of trade
definition: Interference in free competition in business and trade

name: corruption
definition: Dishonest actions by a person in power in return for pecuniary or personal gain

name: bribery
definition: The giving of money or favours in order to influence the judgment or conduct of a person in a position of power

name: cyber crime
definition: Criminal activities carried out by means of computers or the internet, such as hacking, phishing scams and identity theft

name: drug related crimes
definition: Illegal activities involving illicit substances, including buying, distribution, selling and smuggling

name: drug trafficking
definition: Dealing in illicit often harmful substances

name: fraud
definition: Intentional deception for personal or financial gain

name: tax evasion
definition: The illegal evasion of taxes by individuals, corporations, and trusts

name: genocide
definition: The systematic killing of one clan, tribe, or religious or ethnic group by another

name: hijacking
definition: Taking over a transportation vehicle by force

name: homicide
definition: The killing of one person by another, including murder and manslaughter

name: human smuggling and trafficking
definition: The illegal transporting of people from one country or area to another. When the result is forced labour or sexual exploitation, the crime is considered trafficking.

name: kidnapping
definition: To seize and detain a person against that person's will by unlawful threat, force or fraud

name: organised crime
definition: Crimes committed by gangs or criminal organizations, such as the mafia

name: gang activity
definition: Criminal activities by groups of individuals, who are allied by common territories, languages or ethnic backgrounds and identify by a common group identity by using a shared name, tattoo, hand sign, clothing style or graffiti symbol

name: reckless driving
definition: Serious traffic violations that are likely to, or have led to, the endangerment, injury or death of a person or persons, or the endangerment of or significant property damage

name: robbery and theft
definition: The taking of another person's property without their consent, sometimes by force

name: shootings
definition: An act of violence committed by individuals with the use of armed weapons

name: terrorism
definition: Violence against people to create fear in order to achieve political or ideological objectives

name: torture
definition: Intentionally inflicting severe physical or psychological pain in order to punish the victim or get the victim to take an action or give information

name: vandalism
definition: Deliberately damaging or destroying public or private property

name: war crime
definition: Crimes committed during a war or armed conflict, usually against civilians or prisoners of war, including the prosecution of such crimes

name: judiciary
definition: The system of courts of law

name: court
definition: Place where legal cases are heard and decided

name: appeal (court)
definition: Process in which parties request a formal change to an official decision

name: court administration (retired)
definition: Court clerks, bailiffs, stenographers etc. (retired)

name: judge
definition: Official who decides cases in a court of law and passes sentences on those found guilty

name: supreme and high court
definition: matters related to supreme or high courts, including nominations and rulings

name: trial (court)
definition: The process by which evidence is presented and guilt, innocence or culpability is determined

name: defendant (retired)
definition: The person on trial (retired)

name: litigation
definition: Taking disputed issues to court for settlement by judge and/or jury

name: pre-trial
definition: Actions that happen before the start of a trial, such as pleas, bail motions, discovery and depositions

name: sentencing (criminal)
definition: The retribution handed out to those who break laws

name: capital punishment
definition: The legally authorised execution of someone as punishment for a crime

name: court-ordered psychiatric treatment
definition: Psychiatric treatment imposed upon persons with mental health conditions in prisons and jails or as a condition of probation, supervision or parole

name: fine (penalty)
definition: Money that a court of law or other authority decides has to be paid as punishment for a crime or other offence

name: prison
definition: Facility where people are held as a punishment for a crime they have committed or while awaiting trial

name: suspended sentence
definition: Legal arrangement where a judge delays the serving of a sentence by a person who has been found guilty of a crime in order to give them a probationary period

name: witness (retired)
definition: A person who testifies (retired)

name: out of court procedures
definition: Legal issues which are settled outside of court

name: arbitration and mediation
definition: Resolution of disputed issues by a neutral panel, including conciliation, negotiation and tribunals

name: prosecution and prosecutors
definition: The process of holding a trial against a person who is accused of a crime to determine guilt and the lawyers and legal team who argue that the accused is guilty

name: justice (retired)
definition: The equitable administration of laws and regulations (retired)

name: law
definition: The codification of rules of behaviour

name: administrative law
definition: Body of law that governs the actions of governmental administrative agencies

name: civil law
definition: The system of law focused on private rights and disputes between individuals in such areas as contracts, torts, property, and family law

name: regulations
definition: laws that guide the conduct and organization of business corporations

name: antitrust regulations
definition: laws to promote competition between companies for the benefit of consumers

name: criminal law
definition: The system of law concerned with the punishment of those who commit crimes

name: international law
definition: The system of laws embraced by all nations, such as the Geneva Convention and the International Law of the Seas

name: extradition
definition: Legal transfer of criminals or suspects between countries

name: international court and tribunal
definition: The activities of courts under the authority of international organizations or formed by treaties between nations, such as the European Court for Human Rights and International Court of Justice

name: law enforcement
definition: Agencies that attempt to prevent disobedience to established laws or bring to justice those who disobey those laws

name: arrest
definition: The detention of a suspect of a crime

name: investigation (criminal)
definition: Inquiry into an alleged crime, including searching, interviews, interrogations and evidence collection

name: dropped criminal investigation
definition: When police and/or prosecutors end an investigation without a conclusion

name: missing person
definition: An adult whose disappearance is possibly not voluntary, or a child whose whereabouts are unknown to the child's legal guardian

name: police
definition: Civil force of a national, regional or local government that is responsible for the prevention and detection of crime and the maintenance of public order

name: surveillance
definition: Monitoring the activities of the individual through the use of cameras and data in order to prevent or uncover criminal activities

name: disaster, accident and emergency incident
definition: Man made or natural event resulting in loss of life or injury to living creatures and/or damage to inanimate objects or property

name: accident and emergency incident
definition: A sudden, unexpected event that causes unwanted consequences or requires immediate action

name: drowning
definition: When a person's airpipe and lungs become filled with water causing death or injury, most often caused by falling into or bathing in rivers, lakes or the ocean

name: explosion accident and incident
definition: Explosions caused by an accidental, non-combat, or non-terrorism source. Also use when the source of the explosion is non-specified or unknown

name: industrial accident and incident
definition: Any unplanned event or mishap in an industrial setting that result in injuries to people and damage to property or the environment

name: nuclear accident and incident
definition: Any unplanned event that causes unwanted consequences involving radioactive materials

name: structural failure
definition: The unexpected collapse of a building, bridge or other structure

name: transportation accident and incident
definition: An accident or incident involving one or more vehicles

name: air and space accident and incident
definition: An accident or incident involving aircrafts or spacecrafts

name: maritime accident and incident
definition: An accident or incident involving marine vessels.

name: railway accident and incident
definition: An accident or incident involving trains.

name: road accident and incident
definition: An accident or incident involving road vehicles.

name: wildlife traffic accident
definition: Traffic accidents involving wild animals

name: disaster
definition: A sudden, unplanned event that causes great damage or loss of life, such as an accident or a natural catastrophe

name: famine
definition: Severe lack of food for a large population

name: fire
definition: Fires started by an accidental or unknown source. For wildfires, use wildfire. For fires started with a criminal intent, use arson.

name: wildfire
definition: An uncontrolled fire in an area of combustible vegetation

name: natural disaster
definition: Destructive incidents caused by nature, such as earthquakes and floods

name: drought
definition: A severe lack of water over a period of time

name: earthquake
definition: The shifting of the tectonic plates of the Earth, creating in some cases damage to structures

name: flood
definition: Surfeit of water, caused by heavy rains or melting snow, usually in places where it's not wanted

name: landslide
definition: Sudden dislodging of massive amounts of snow or soil

name: avalanche
definition: A sudden fall of snow, ice, rock, or mud down the side of a mountain

name: meteorological disaster
definition: A weather-related disaster

name: hurricane
definition: A type of storm also called a tropical cyclone, which forms over tropical or subtropical waters

name: windstorms
definition: A storm with very strong wind but little or no rain or snow

name: tsunami
definition: High and powerful ocean waves caused by an underwater land disturbance, such as an earthquake or volcanic eruption, known to cause significant damage and loss when they hit land

name: volcanic eruption
definition: A rupture in the crust of the Earth allowing molten material to escape to the surface

name: emergency incident (retired)
definition: A sudden, unexpected event that requires immediate action to prevent serious consequences (retired)

name: transport incident (retired)
definition: An incident involving one or more vehicles (retired)

name: air and space incident (retired)
definition: Incident involving craft in air or space. (retired)

name: maritime incident (retired)
definition: Incident involving marine vessels. (retired)

name: railway incident (retired)
definition: Incident involving trains. (retired)

name: road incident (retired)
definition: Incident involving road vehicles. (retired)

name: emergency planning (retired)
definition: Planning for actions to deal with sudden, unplanned events (retired)

name: emergency response
definition: The planning and efforts made by people and organizations to help victims of a sudden, unplanned event, natural disaster or crisis

name: economy, business and finance
definition: All matters concerning the planning, production and exchange of wealth.

name: business enterprise
definition: Organisations set up to create and sell a product or service

name: cooperative
definition: An organisation which is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits of their work

name: small and medium enterprise
definition: A small and medium enterprise (SME) is a company whose number of employees, balance and turnover cannot exceed certain limits set by the country where it is located

name: start-up and entrepreneurial business
definition: The process of designing, launching and running a new business

name: business information
definition: Information about individual business entities, including companies, corporations, charities

name: business finance (retired)
definition: A business entity's finances (retired)

name: analysts comment (retired)
definition: Stock analyst comments, analysis and recommendations. (retired)

name: business financing
definition: The financing, capital structuring, and investment decisions of a business

name: bankruptcy
definition: Organisations that cannot pay their debts and file for special treatment by governments and financial systems

name: corporate bond
definition: Corporate paper representing the loan of money at a fixed rate and for a fixed time to that company or government

name: crowdfunding
definition: The funding of a project or venture by raising small amounts of money from a large number of people, typically via the internet

name: financially distressed company
definition: Indications that a company is financially distressed but not having filed for bankruptcy yet

name: restructuring and recapitalisation (retired)
definition: The sale of company units, splits of existing companies into units under a holding company, etc. (retired)

name: securities (retired)
definition: Markets for trading types of company paper such as stocks and bonds (retired)

name: stock option (retired)

name: stocks and securities
definition: Financial instruments such as company shares and bonds

name: corporate dividends
definition: Distribution of company profits to shareholders via dividend payments

name: derivatives
definition: Financial instruments such as futures, swaps and options that depend on an underlying instrument such as a commodity, bond, equity or currency

name: hot stock (retired)
definition: Remarkable price movements of a particular stock. (retired)

name: stock activity
definition: Announcements of major stock events: splits, block trades, new highs or lows, etc.

name: stock buyback
definition: Corporate actions in which companies buy back their own shares

name: stock flotation
definition: The issuing of stock shares to the public for the first time, also called an Initial Public Offering (IPO)

name: stock recommendation (retired)
definition: An analyst's recommendation for particular stocks. May include the analyst s price target for the stock. (retired)

name: buy recommendation (retired)
definition: An analyst's recommendation to buy particular stocks. May include the analyst s price target for the stock. (retired)

name: hold recommendation (retired)
definition: An analyst's recommendation to hold particular stocks. May include the analyst s price target for the stock. (retired)

name: sell recommendation (retired)
definition: An analyst's recommendation to sell particular stocks. May include the analyst s price target for the stock. (retired)

name: business governance
definition: The rules, practices, and processes used to oversee and manage a company

name: annual and special corporate meeting
definition: News surrounding company reports and annual or special corporate meetings

name: annual report
definition: Availability or contents of annual company reports.

name: board of directors
definition: Appointments to or changes in the board of directors for a company.

name: environmental, social and governance policy (ESG)
definition: A company's business practices reflecting responsible social, ethical and environmental policies, sometimes known as corporate social responsibility

name: proxy filing
definition: Filings with regulatory agencies of proxy statements for upcoming shareholder votes.

name: shareholder activity
definition: Actions taken by owners of one or more shares of a company, including shareholder activism

name: business reporting and performance
definition: Measuring and reporting on the performance of a business

name: accounting and audit (retired)
definition: Changes regarding applicable accounting rules and the audit of accounting (retired)

name: corporate earnings
definition: Announcements and discussions of corporate earnings

name: credit rating
definition: Formal statements by certain rating agencies on the investment risk of a company or enterprise

name: earnings forecast (retired)
definition: Analyst prediction of company earnings. (retired)

name: financial statement
definition: Formal statements about the company financials typically delivered annually or quarterly

name: business restructuring
definition: Changes to the structure of a business or organisation

name: company spin-off
definition: The creation of new companies being spun off from existing companies

name: joint venture
definition: Two or more companies agreeing on a venture.

name: leveraged buyout
definition: Acquiring control over a company by buying its shares with borrowed money.

name: management buyout
definition: Acquiring control over a company by the management buying its shares.

name: merger or acquisition
definition: Two or more companies forming a new company mergers, takeovers or acquisitions.

name: business strategy and marketing
definition: Planning the direction of a company and selling its products and services to achieve the strategy

name: client relationship management
definition: Creating and maintaining a relationship with the customers to increase sales.

name: commercial contract
definition: Contracts regarding commercial activities

name: economic globalisation
definition: Doing business around the world

name: licensing agreement (retired)
definition: The document defining the terms for licensing intellectual property (retired)

name: market research
definition: Gathering information about the needs and wants of consumers

name: market trend
definition: Statistically significant consumer behaviour.

name: new product or service
definition: The introduction of products or services to the market

name: outsourcing
definition: Business practice in which services or job functions are farmed out to a third party

name: patent, copyright and trademark
definition: Intellectual properties such as patents, copyright and trademarks

name: product recall
definition: A decision by a company to take back or repair a defective product

name: public contract
definition: Written contracts between companies and public authorities for the execution of works, the supply of products or the provision of services.

name: research and development
definition: Research and expenditure on new product or service development

name: human resources
definition: People working for a business and how they are managed

name: executive officer
definition: Company executive officers including appointments and changes

name: layoffs and downsizing
definition: Planned or actual reductions in the labour force.

name: economy
definition: Production, consumption, distribution and trade activities affecting regions or countries as a whole

name: central bank
definition: A country's major bank that sets interest rates and provides transfer of funds between commercial banks

name: currency
definition: The system of money used by a country, including the value of one currency as measured against another

name: cryptocurrency
definition: An internet-based medium of exchange using cryptography to conduct financial transactions

name: economic organisation
definition: Business, industrial and trade associations, societies and other private-sector groups

name: economic trends and indicators
definition: The behaviour and performance of the economy as a whole

name: bonds (retired)
definition: Corporate or governmental paper representing the loan of money at a fixed rate and for a fixed time to that company or government (retired)

name: budgets and budgeting (retired)
definition: A method of balancing revenues against expenses (retired)

name: consumer confidence
definition: A measure of consumers' feelings about current and future economic conditions, including prices, inflation and the quality of retail goods, used as an indicator of the overall state of the economy

name: consumers (retired)
definition: Buyers of goods and services (retired)

name: consumer issue (retired)
definition: Issues, such as prices, inflation/deflation, quality of goods, at the retail sales level (retired)

name: credit and debt (retired)
definition: Credit: the amount of money available to you, often by loan. Debt: the amount you owe. (retired)

name: deflation
definition: The decrease in the general price level of goods and services within an economy

name: economic growth
definition: An increase of the gross domestic product (GDP)

name: economic indicator (retired)
definition: Certain indexes, such as company inventories, the movement of prices that show whether the economy is improving or declining (retired)

name: employment statistics
definition: Trends and statistics about areas such as job growth, unemployment and wage growth

name: exporting

name: Scientology
definition: A set of beliefs and practices invented by American science fiction author L. Ron Hubbard asserting that a human is an immortal, spiritual being (Thetan) that is resident in a physical body

name: Shintoism
definition: An indigenous Japanese polytheistic religion that revolves around kami, supernatural entities believed to inhabit all things

name: Sikhism
definition: An Indian Dharmic religion that originated at the end of the 15th century CE in the Punjab region, developed from the spiritual teachings of Guru Nanak

name: Taoism
definition: A philosophical and spiritual tradition originating in the 4th century BCE in China which emphasizes living in harmony with the Tao, the source, pattern and substance of everything that exists

name: Unificationism
definition: A religion founded in 1954 in South Korea following the teachings of Rev. Syn Myung Moon and known for its mass wedding ceremonies

name: Zoroastrianism
definition: A religion originating in ancient Iran following the teachings of the prophet Zoroaster, predicting the triumph of good over evil and exalting the benevolent deity of wisdom, Ahura Mazda (Wise Lord), as its supreme being

name: atheism and agnosticism
definition: The belief that god does not exist or that it is impossible to know whether a god exists

name: cult
definition: A group that consists of followers who are fully devoted to a charismatic leader. Members are sometimes exploited financially or subject to emotional or physical harm

name: nature religion
definition: Religions that believe nature and the natural world is an embodiment of divinity, sacredness or spiritual power, including indigenous religions practiced in various parts of the world, and modern Pagan faiths, such as Wicca

name: interreligious dialogue (retired)
definition: Any form of communication between religions (retired)

name: relations between religion and government
definition: Matters arising from the relationship between religions and a government, including the question of whether churches should pay taxes, the push to keep religion out of publicly funded institutions and the freedom, or lack of to wear religious symbols in a school setting

name: religious conflict
definition: Conflicts involving religious differences

name: religious event (retired)
definition: News regarding a religious event but not a festival or holiday (retired)

name: religious facility
definition: Any facility where a group carries out its religious rites

name: church
definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Christian religion

name: mosque
definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Islamic religion

name: synagogue
definition: A building used as a place of worship for the Jewish religion

name: temple (retired)
definition: Generally an edifice identifiable as a place of worship (retired)

name: religious festival and holiday
definition: Holy day or period of observance in a religion which is sometimes a public holiday

name: All Saints Day
definition: Christian festival celebrated in honour of all the saints, known and unknown. Holiday is also known as All Hallows' Day, Hallowmas, Feast of All Saints or Solemnity of All Saints.

name: Christmas
definition: Christian holiday that celebrates the birth of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

name: Easter
definition: Christian festival commemorating the resurrection of Jesus Christ. Is also celebrated by many as a secular holiday.

name: Eid al-Adha
definition: Muslim festival marking the culmination of the annual hajj pilgrimage and commemorating the willingness of the Prophet Ibrahim to sacrifice his son

name: Hanukkah
definition: Jewish festival, sometimes spelled Chanukah, observed by lighting the candles of a menorah

name: Pentecost
definition: Christian festival, celebrated on the 50th day after Easter commemorating the descent of the Holy Spirit, also known as Whitsun

name: Ramadan
definition: Holy month of fasting in Islam concluding in Eid al-Fitr

name: Walpurgis night
definition: The eve of the Christian feast day of Saint Walpurga, an 8th-century abbess in Francia, celebrated on the night of 30 April and the day of 1 May

name: Yom Kippur
definition: Most solemn of Jewish religious holidays, observed on the 10th day of the lunar month of tishri by fasting and prayer from sunset to sundown the following day

name: religious leader
definition: Person or persons who have a ritual, juridical or otherwise leading role in their respective church or religion

name: pope
definition: Head of the Roman Catholic Church worldwide

name: religious ritual
definition: Established religious rituals such as mass, baptism, prayer meetings and bar and bat mitzvah

name: baptism
definition: A Christian religious rite, sometimes also called a Christening, involving the sprinkling of holy water onto a person's forehead or immersing them in water, symbolising purification and admission to the Church

name: bar and bat mitzvah
definition: Young person becoming an adult in the Jewish faith

name: canonisation
definition: The declaration of a deceased person as an officially recognised saint

name: religious text
definition: Texts regarded as holy or important by a religion

name: Bible
definition: Holy book of Christianity

name: Qur'an
definition: Holy book of Islam

name: Torah
definition: Holy book of Judaism

name: science and technology
definition: All aspects pertaining to human understanding of, as well as methodical study and research of natural, formal and social sciences, such as astronomy, linguistics or economics

name: biomedical science
definition: The application of biology-based science to medical fields such as research, health monitoring or medical treatment

name: biotechnology
definition: The scientific manipulation of living organisms and biological processes for scientific, medical or agricultural purposes

name: mathematics
definition: The study of structure, space, change and number in abstract, often using symbolic logic and language, and including subjects such as geometry, algebra or trigonometry

name: natural science
definition: The sciences that deal with matter, energy and the physical world, including physics, biology, chemistry and astronomy

name: astronomy
definition: The study of celestial objects through direct observation and theoretical models

name: biology
definition: The study of the anatomy, behaviour, origin, physiology and other aspects of living organisms

name: botany
definition: The study of the physical and physiological structure, genetics, ecology and other aspects of plants

name: genetics
definition: The study of genes in living organisms, and of their role in heredity, development or genetic adaptation

name: palaeontology
definition: The study of prehistoric life forms, geological periods and fossils

name: physiology
definition: The study of the vital processes, internal organs or functional mechanisms of living organisms

name: zoology
definition: The study of the biology, physiology, development, behaviour or other aspects of animals

name: chemistry
definition: The study of the composition and properties of matter on the scale of atoms and molecules, and of the reactions between compounds

name: cosmology
definition: The study of the origin, evolution, organisation and structure of the universe

name: geology
definition: The study of Earth's physical processes, material structures and its properties

name: horticulture
definition: The study and art of plant cultivation, including landscape and garden design and plant conservation

name: marine science
definition: The study of living organisms and environments in saltwater ecosystems

name: meteorology
definition: The study of atmospheric chemistry and physics, with a focus on weather forecasting

name: physics
definition: The study of the movement and structure of matter, and how it relates to energy

name: electromagnetism
definition: The study of the physical interactions between electrically charged particles and magnetic fields

name: nuclear physics
definition: The study of the structure and behaviour of atomic nuclei

name: particle physics
definition: The study of the nature, properties and interactions of the elementary particles that constitute matter

name: scientific institution
definition: Institution that carries out or governs scientific work, such as the National Academy of Arts and Sciences

name: scientific research
definition: The scientific and methodical investigation of events, procedures and interactions to explain why they occur, or to find solutions for problems

name: medical research
definition: Investigation conducted in the fields of health and medicine, such as genetic studies, disease research or pharmaceutical drug trials

name: scientific exploration
definition: Land, sea or space journeys undertaken to discover new information

name: space exploration
definition: The scientific exploration of outer space through manned and unmanned missions

name: scientific innovation
definition: The development or creation of new scientific or technological products or processes, such as biotech or artificial intelligence applications, robotic limbs or nanoscale cameras

name: scientific publication
definition: Academic research findings published in a journal, book or thesis

name: scientific standards
definition: Nationally or internationally established rules governing scientific and technological study and development, such as calibration standards for scientific tools or equipment

name: social sciences
definition: The study of human society in such aspects as linguistics, anthropology, economics or sociology

name: anthropology
definition: The study of human behaviour and social interactions across time

name: archaeology
definition: The study of human activity throughout time and cultural history, using artefacts left behind by ancient peoples

name: economics
definition: The study of the laws and principles of economies, such as the production and distribution of goods and services

name: geography
definition: The study of the physical features of the surface of Earth and its political divisions

name: history
definition: The study of human events of the past

name: information science
definition: The study and practice of collecting, classifying, storing, retrieving and disseminating information

name: linguistics
definition: The study of all aspects of human language such as syntax, phonetics, written and spoken forms and variations over time

name: philosophy
definition: The study of the principles and fundamental questions about matters such as the mind, reason, morality or values

name: political science
definition: The study of the principles of political and governmental systems, political thought and practices

name: psychology
definition: The study of the human mind, mental characteristics and emotional processes

name: sociology
definition: The study of human social organisation, social relationships and societal changes

name: study of law
definition: The study of legal systems and the philosophy of law

name: technology and engineering
definition: The study and practice of industrial or applied sciences such as physics, hydrodynamics or thermodynamics

name: aerospace engineering
definition: The study, design, development and construction of aircraft, spacecraft and missile systems

name: rocketry
definition: The study, design, development and construction of rockets

name: agricultural technology
definition: The study and development of techniques and machinery to improve agricultural management and productivity

name: civil engineering
definition: The study, design, development and construction of structures such as buildings, bridges, tunnels, irrigation and sewage systems, streets or railroads

name: electronic engineering
definition: The study, design, development and application of systems built on the exchange of electrical charges, such as consumer devices, communications systems or industrial computers

name: identification technology
definition: The study, development, application and ethical considerations of technological methods for identifying products, animals or people; including radio frequency, biometrics or face recognition

name: information technology and computer science
definition: The study and design of computer systems, software and networks

name: artificial intelligence
definition: An attempt to let computers simulate how the human brain works by applying statistical, heuristic or machine learning methods and algorithms to large datasets. Enables a long range of automatic functions like image recognition and categorisation.

name: materials science
definition: The study of the composition, structure and properties of materials for their use in industry and manufacturing

name: mechanical engineering
definition: The study and application of the design, construction and operation of mechanical systems

name: micro science
definition: The study of and technologies built at a microscopic scale, such as microbiology or microcomputing

name: nanotechnology
definition: Manipulating objects at the molecular scale

name: society
definition: The concerns, issues, affairs and institutions relevant to human social interactions, problems and welfare, such as poverty, human rights and family planning

name: communities
definition: A group of individuals actively sharing a common value or interest

name: fraternal and community group
definition: Social organisations whose members freely associate for a mutually beneficial purpose such as for social, professional or honorary principles. Groups include Rotary clubs, Lions clubs or Freemasons.

name: social networking
definition: Social interactions, either in person or online, intended to share information and build relationships around common interests

name: demographic group
definition: A subset of society with shared traits

name: LGBTQ
definition: People who identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender or queer

name: adults
definition: People above an age set by law that entitles them to full liability and certain privileges such as the legal right to drink alcoholic beverages and to vote

name: children
definition: Young people, usually pre-pubescent, who are legally considered minors and are in a guardianship relationship with adults

name: disabilities
definition: Physical or mental conditions that limit a person's movements, senses, or activities

name: gender
definition: The classification of individuals as male, female, or a non-binary designation

name: indigenous people
definition: People who are the original owners and caretakers of a given region, also known as native peoples, first peoples or aboriginal peoples, in contrast to groups that have settled, occupied or colonised the area more recently

name: infants
definition: Very young people, usually defined as being just born up to the age of two

name: men
definition: People who identify as male, focusing on the group as a demographic, and masculinity

name: national or ethnic minority
definition: Groups of people that form a minority on an ethnic or national basis, and their status or issues relating to the majority

name: nuclear radiation victims (retired)
definition: Includes antinuclear movements and compensation for atomic blast victims. (retired)

name: senior citizens
definition: People having passed the age of retirement

name: teenagers
definition: Young people between the ages that describe childhood and adulthood

name: women
definition: People who identify as female, focusing on the group as a demographic, and accomplishments, such as the first woman to achieve a milestone or serve in a role

name: demographics
definition: The study of human populations and their characteristics, for example statistics or trends around aging populations in a particular geographic region

name: population and census
definition: The official count of people living in a given geopolitical area, usually carried out by a governmental body

name: discrimination
definition: Unfair treatment of, or policies or practices against, individuals or groups of people on the basis of real or perceived membership in a group, such as race, sexual orientation, political or religious beliefs, age or height

name: ageism
definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people on the basis of age

name: racism
definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people on the basis of race

name: religious discrimination
definition: Unfair treatment of individuals or groups of people on the basis of their religious belief

name: sexism
definition: Discrimination against individuals or groups of people, usually women, on the basis of gender

name: diversity, equity and inclusion
definition: Efforts that seeks to promote the fair treatment and full participation of groups of people who have historically been underrepresented or subject to discrimination on the basis of identity or disability

name: emigration
definition: Leaving one's country of residence to settle permanently elsewhere

name: family
definition: A group of people related genetically or by a legal bond, or who consider themselves part of a familial unit regardless of genetic or legal status

name: Dating and Relationships
definition: The development of an intimate connection between individuals, through various forms of activities enjoyed together, often leading to a legal or permanent union such as marriage

name: adoption
definition: The legal process of transferring parental rights to someone other than a person's birth parents, that person usually being a child

name: divorce
definition: The process by which a marriage is legally dissolved

name: family planning
definition: Services and education aimed at informing individual decisions about reproduction, such as fertility, in vitro fertilisation, contraception or abortion

name: abortion
definition: The intentional termination of a pregnancy for elective or medical reasons

name: contraception
definition: A method or device used to prevent pregnancy

name: marriage
definition: The legal or socially recognised union of individuals, which establishes rights and obligations between them

name: parenting
definition: The caring for and support of a child's physical, emotional, developmental and social needs from birth to adulthood

name: pregnancy and childbirth
definition: Social and medical issues around pregnancy and giving birth including, doulas and midwives, obstetrics and medical concerns

name: fundamental rights
definition: The political, social, cultural and economic rights to which all people are entitled, usually upheld by law

name: censorship and freedom of speech
definition: The right to express opinions without restraint and attempts to supress speech by an organisation or individual

name: civil rights
definition: Guarantees of protection to individuals  freedom from violation by governments, political and social organisations, and other individuals as determined by the laws or constitutions of an individual country

name: freedom of religion
definition: The right to practice the religion of one's choosing and efforts to violate this right through the intimidation of believers or laws that encroach on religious rituals

name: freedom of the press
definition: The right of the press to report on stories freely and efforts by governments, organizations or individuals to suppress, jail or kill journalists who are reporting the news

name: human rights
definition: Rights entitled to be enjoyed by all people universally

name: privacy
definition: The right of an individual or group to keep information about themselves private

name: women's rights
definition: The rights of women to be treated equally as men, such as pay parity, feminism and bodily autonomy around abortion

name: immigration
definition: The movement of individuals or groups of people from one country to another

name: illegal immigration
definition: The movement of individuals or groups of people from one country to another without legal authorisation from the destination country

name: social condition
definition: The circumstances or state of affairs affecting a person's life, welfare and relations with others in a society

name: homelessness
definition: The social condition defined by lack of permanent residence, living in shelters or on streets, and the issues and problems associated with it

name: poverty
definition: The lack of sufficient resources and means to provide basic needs such as food, clothing or shelter for oneself and one's family

name: social problem
definition: Issues related to human rights, human welfare and other areas of societal concern

name: abusive behaviour
definition: Actions that intentionally harm another person or people, often on an ongoing basis, such as psychological or mental abuse, negligence, physical or sexual abuse and torture

name: addiction
definition: The habitual and compulsive use of substances such as alcohol or drugs, or behaviour such as gambling, gaming or sex, often causing detrimental effects on the body, brain, and relationships with others

name: bullying
definition: Taking actions meant to harm, coerce and intimidate another person perceived as vulnerable. These actions can be taken in person or online.

name: juvenile delinquency
definition: Unlawful conduct perpetrated by minors, often on a repeated basis

name: prostitution
definition: The business of engaging in sexual activity in exchange for payment

name: sexual misconduct
definition: Unwanted behaviour of a sexual nature that is of lesser offense than felony sexual assault, particularly when behaviour occurs in a normally non-sexual situation, or where there is some aspect of personal power or authority involved

name: slavery
definition: The ownership of people as property, and the involuntary servitude of those people to their owners, which includes unpaid labour and coerced actions

name: values
definition: A person's or group's principles or standards of behaviour, which guide their way of living and choices made

name: corrupt practices (retired)
definition: Any action which is harmful to others (retired)

name: death and dying
definition: Social, medical and mental health issues relating to people at the end of their lives

name: euthanasia
definition: The practice of humanely ending the life of a person suffering from a terminal illness

name: assisted suicide
definition: The practice of assisting a person suffering from a terminal illness in the process of suicide, often with a physician's oversight

name: suicide
definition: The intentional taking of one's own life

name: ethics
definition: The moral values and standards that define right and wrong actions or decisions

name: pornography
definition: The depiction of sexually explicit acts in various media renditions, such as video or photos, often considered obscene or immoral

name: sexual behaviour
definition: The manner in which people express their sexuality in physical acts

name: welfare
definition: Help for those in need of food, housing, health and other services

name: charity
definition: The voluntary giving of money, food or other necessities to those in need

name: child care
definition: Services and facilities that look after children while their parents are working or away, including daycare centres and programmes

name: elderly care
definition: The long-term care of the elderly provided by residential institutions or by paid daily help in the home

name: long-term care
definition: Services provided on an extended and ongoing basis to patients suffering from chronic illness or disability

name: public housing
definition: Housing that is owned or managed by a government or nonprofit organisation and rented to tenants with the aim of making housing affordable. Eligibility for such housing arrangements varies country to country.

name: social services
definition: Social programmes, usually publicly sponsored, aimed at promoting people's welfare, such as housing, health care or education services

name: sport
definition: Competitive activity or skill that involves physical and/or mental effort and organisations and bodies involved in these activities

name: competition discipline
definition: Different types of sport which can be executed in competitions

name: 3x3 basketball
definition: A variation of basketball played three a side on one basketball hoop

name: American football
definition: Team ball game that opposes two teams of 11 that have offence and defence sections. Each offence attempts to move an oval ball down the 120 yards long field. Points are scored by advancing the ball into the opposing team s end zone.

name: Australian rules football
definition: A form of football played by two teams of 18 competing on a pitch by running with and passing an oval ball. Points are scored by moving the ball between goal posts. Governed by the Australian Football League.

name: Canadian football
definition: Team ball game that opposes two teams of 12 that have offence and defence sections. Each offence attempts to move an oval ball down the 150 yards long field. Points are scored by advancing the ball into the opposing team s end zone.

name: Gaelic football
definition: A form of football played by two teams of 15 competing on a pitch by running with, kicking and passing a spherical ball. Points are scored by moving the ball between goal posts. Governed by the Gaelic Athletic Association.

name: Jai Alai (Pelota)
definition: A fast ball play using either the bare hand or a wicker scoop in an arena of walls of different outlay and size

name: archery
definition: Archers use bows and arrows to aim at targets 1.22 metres in diameter which are on average 70 metres distant.

name: crossbow shooting
definition: Shooting with crossbow on targets from different distances

name: longbow
definition: Shooting with longbow on targets from different distances. The competition is held outdoors on an open (flat) field.

name: arm wrestling
definition: A form of wrestling in which two participants grapple arm-to-arm

name: artistic swimming
definition: A sport in which swimmers, in solo, duet or team configurations, perform coordinated or identical movements in time to music. They are judged and are awarded points for body position, control, and the degree of difficulty of the moves.

name: synchronised free routine
definition: In the free programme, music, movements and their order of execution are not restricted.

name: synchronised technical routine
definition: Contestants obtain points from 10 sitting judges by executing certain synchronised artistic shapes and movements in the water. In the technical programme, competitors must execute a range of specific moves in a given order.

name: athletics
definition: Competitions involving foot races, jumping and throwing which can be on a track inside a stadium or on outside roads

name: cross-country run
definition: Competitors run over rough ground and not on a track

name: decathlon
definition: Individual men's competition which involves accumulating points in 10 different disciplines over two days: 1st day - 100m, long-jump, shot-putt, high-jump, 400m. 2nd day - 110m hurdles, discus, pole-vault, javelin and 1,500 metres.

name: discus throw
definition: Competitors stand in a netted circle with a 2.50 metres diameter and with a turning motion attempt to throw a discus weighing 2kg for men and 1kg for women as far as possible

name: hammer throw
definition: Competitors throw a hammer consisting of a metal ball, chain and handle as far as they can from a netted circle which is 2.13 metres in diameter. The hammer weighs 7.26kg for men and 4kg for women

name: heptathlon
definition: Competition involving seven separate disciplines over two days. 1st day - 100m hurdles, high jump, shot put, 200 metres. 2nd day - long-jump, javelin, 800 metres

name: high jump
definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then jump as high as possible over a horizontal bar

name: hurdles
definition: A sprint running race where athletes jump over a series of upright frames

name: javelin throw
definition: Competitors in a specially-designated throwing area attempt to fling a spear-like javelin as far as possible. The javelin weighs 800 grams for men and 600 grams for women.

name: long distance run
definition: A running race at distances for more than 1500 metres

name: long jump
definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then jump in one leap as far as possible

name: middle distance run
definition: A running race at distances for more than 400 metres and up to and including 1500 metres

name: pentathlon
definition: Only indoor, 60m hurdles, high jump, shot put, long jump, 800 m

name: pole vault
definition: Competitors use a flexible pole to propel themselves feet-first into the air and clear a bar which is raised higher at each round of jumps.

name: race walking
definition: A race requiring the competitor to have always one foot on the ground

name: relay run
definition: A team of athletes run a relay over identical distances

name: shot put
definition: Competitors stand in a circle with a 2.13 metres diameter and attempt to throw a metal ball weighing 7.26 kg for men and 4kg for women as far as possible. The longest throw wins.

name: sprint run
definition: A running race at distances of up to and including 400 metres

name: steeplechase (athletics)
definition: Obstacle race in athletics including barriers and water jumps

name: triple jump
definition: Competitors build up speed over a short sprint and then attempt to jump as far forward as they can using a hop, skip and a jump technique.

name: badminton
definition: Two players or two teams of two compete by hitting a shuttlecock weighing approximately five grams over a high net. The aim for each player/team is to prevent the shuttlecock landing on their side of the court.

name: bandy
definition: Played outdoors on ice. The size of the ice rink is about the size of a soccer field. Skates like ice hockey. A small hard ball is used for playing. Players play with sticks, much like in ice hockey, but the sticks are shorter and more rounded than in ice

name: baseball
definition: A game between two teams of nine played on an enclosed ground. The team which scores the most points wins. A point is scored when a player runs around the ground marked out by four bases. To do this he has to hit the ball thrown at him by a rival player.

name: rubberball baseball
definition: Sometimes called ''soft baseball,'' the game is played with a rubber baseball of varying degrees of hardness depending upon the age and level of the players.

name: basketball
definition: Game played between two teams of five - points are scored by placing the large inflated ball into a net fixed on a ring 3.05m above the ground.

name: biathlon
definition: A combination of cross-country skiing and target shooting on a 12.5 K course in a pursuit format.

name: billiards
definition: A cue sport with balls on a table without a specific order to play them

name: bobsleigh
definition: One, two or four people racing down a course in a sled that consists of a main hull, a frame, two axles and sets of runners. The total time of all heats in a competition is added together to determine the winner.

name: bodybuilding
definition: Competitions where participants perform specific poses to display their muscles that have been strengthened and enlarged through strenuous exercise. Competitors are judged based on criteria such as symmetry, muscularity and conditioning.

name: boules
definition: Collective name of a number of games where the common goal is to move the competitor's balls as close to a small target ball as possible, played on a grass or sand surface. Balls are thrown (as in petanque and boules) or rolled (as in lawn bowls or bocce).

name: boxing
definition: Combat sport in which two men/women fight using only their fists covered by padded gloves in a square ring measuring 6m a side. The fight is usually split into 12 rounds of three minutes each.

name: bullfighting
definition: Classical contest pitting man against the bull

name: canoe slalom
definition: Competitors navigate a canoe or a kayak on a white-water course, passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates on river rapids in the fastest time possible

name: canoe sprint
definition: Taking place on a flatwater course, multiple canoes take off at once and race each other to the finish

name: canoeing
definition: Competition involving canoes which are generally kneeled and paddled with a single-bladed paddle

name: C1 (canoeing) (retired)
definition: One-seater canoe (open boat with competitor using a single bladed paddle (retired)

name: C2 (canoeing) (retired)
definition: Two-seater canoe (open boat) - competitors use a single bladed paddle (retired)

name: C4 (canoeing) (retired)
definition: Four-seater canoe (open boat) with each competitor using a single bladed paddle (retired)

name: canoe sailing (retired)
definition: A race involving a canoe equipped with a sail. (retired)

name: pontoniering (retired)
definition: Team sport, military tradition, similar to canoe regatta, in boats (retired)

name: casting (fishing)
definition: Using fishing equipment to hit a target and score points

name: cheerleading
definition: Cheer squads competing against each other to perform a routine that includes stunts, jumps and tumbling set to music. Squads are judged on difficulty and execution.

name: chess
definition: Competition between two players using a chequered board with 16 pieces to each side, each with specific ranges of movement depending on their identity

name: competitive dancing
definition: Dancing competition where competitors are judged on technique and interpretation.

name: breaking (breakdance)
definition: Dancing competition featuring an urban dance style that originated in the United States in the 1970s with roots in hip-hop culture and characterised by acrobatic movements, stylised footwork, and the key role played by the DJ and the MC during battles

name: cricket
